camera.interpolation: bounded C1 monotone cubic on log(scale), continuous center and unwrapped projected heading; do not ease to zero at every sample
camera.zoomHoldEvidence: Static reference keyframes are constraints, not freeze-frame instructions.
camera.pitchPolicy: no claimed recovered pitch/FOV/altitude; use existing approved plan and solve measured image constraints
camera.measurementCaveat: Mask-derived bbox/centroids are approximate image constraints, not real camera calibration. Fit to unchanged supplied geometry; report residuals rather than distorting shapes.

events.timingNote: chosen exact authoring envelope around visually observed onset

events.direction: SUPPLIED_START_TO_END; observed screen lower-left to upper-right

events.sourceTruth: reference text only, not independently verified geography

notObservedAndNotToInvent: return to overview before clip ends

missingBindings.requiredFormat: Verified geographic identity and EPSG:4326 Point [longitude,latitude], source identifier/hash/date and positional uncertainty. The tiny hero place is not identified from pixels alone.

License-cleared detailed GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in EPSG:4326, native vertex precision, scale/uncertainty, provenance and SHA-256. No screenshot tracing or synthetic coast accepted as measured geometry.

License-cleared ordered GeoJSON LineString in EPSG:4326 with real endpoints, direction, source/hash, uncertainty, and definition of the explained boundary. Arclength reveal follows the unmodified input ordering.

One coherent license-cleared basemap or evidence-backed source hierarchy covering the entire rotated camera envelope, with detailed local native pixels, dimensions, CRS/registration, extent, native resolution, parent SHA-256 and NoData. Upscaled global color pixels are not new source detail.

unverifiedClaims.requiredFormat: Independent source, measurement definition, date and uncertainty if 85 m is to be stated as geographic fact. The video only supports reference-observed display text.

locations.displayNameBasis: Provided reference analysis; authored display text, not a survey identity claim
Provided reference analysis; authored display text, not a survey identity claim

canonicalFeatureHashMethod: SHA256 of Python json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)).encode(UTF-8). Source-native JSON numeric values retained; this method is specified, not assumed interchangeable with other cross-language number serializers.

coarseSelectionNotes.contextRegion: Existing COUNTRY_MAR selected explicitly for authoring context, not an exact source-pixel or survey-boundary assertion. The original coarse geometry is preserved.
coarseSelectionNotes.boundaryStyleGroups: Existing source CONTINENT properties were used once to author explicit geometry-ID lists. Runtime receives those lists; no nationality/continent branch is added to the engine. Offscreen/full geometry still requires normal projection/source admission.
coarseSelectionNotes.framingSubject: Mainland component4 is explicitly selected as a framing subject only. All12 original MultiPolygon parts remain in the parent render geometry. No coast vertices were moved or removed.
